newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends lower on U.S. currency demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends lower on U.S. currency demand.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its U.S. counterpart on Thursday as the greenback drew some routine month-end demand, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.496 to the U.S. dollar against Wednesday's T$27.494 close. Turnover through dealers was an active US$202.5 million.
Despite commercial demand for the American currency, the rate remained in a narrow range on mild foreign funds inflow, dealers said.
"Demand for the U.S. dollar will be strong for the rest of November, but the rate will not move that much," said one dealer.
A T$27.48-51 range was seen for Friday.
